content_sections.heading: About CNCI
content_sections.text: Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute (CNCI) is a cancer institute in Kolkata, West Bengal. This walk-in is held at its Newtown Campus in New Town, Kolkata. The posts are for Ayushman Bharat Portal work, corporate billing and medical records.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. Bring the documents listed below to the interview. Only candidates with the qualification and experience required for their post should attend.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on an outsourced basis through M/s Debayan Konar, and staff are deployed at Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute, Kolkata. Remuneration shall be as per applicable norms. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the walk-in interview. The competent authority reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process, if required.

faq.question: Q1. How many Ayushman Data Entry Operator posts are there?
faq.answer: There are 02 Ayushman Data Entry Operator posts. Ayushman Assistant and Medical Record Assistant have 01 post each.

faq.question: Q2. Is experience mandatory for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: No. You need to be a graduate in any discipline with a typing speed of 35 WPM. Candidates with 01 year of experience in Ayushman Bharat Portal handling or corporate billing will get preference.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience does the Ayushman Assistant post need?
faq.answer: You need at least 03 years of experience in Ayushman Bharat Portal handling, corporate billing or related activities, along with graduation in any discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required for the Medical Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: You need 01 year of experience working in the Medical Records department of a Cancer Hospital.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is at the 1st Floor, Admin Section, CNCI Newtown Campus, Street No. 299, DJ Block, Action Area 1D, New Town, Kolkata – 700160.

faq.question: Q6. Who will employ the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are engaged through the outsourced agency M/s Debayan Konar and deployed at Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel costs for the interview be reimbursed?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring as photocopies?
faq.answer: Bring self-attested photocopies of your educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and a valid identity proof. Also bring your updated CV and the original certificates.
